description: Retrieve one bounded page of current row strategies plus project technique selections and the active applicable workspace technique catalog. Follow continuationToken until it is null for the requested scope.

inputSchema.description: Use initial scope fields, or continuationToken by itself for a later page.

continuationToken.description: Opaque continuation from the preceding page. When supplied, it must be the only field.

pageSize.description: Initial-call page size from 1 to 100; defaults to 25 and is bound into continuationToken.

projectId.description: RiskRover project ID for an initial call; omit when using continuationToken.

qualityId.description: Optional quality scope for an initial call.

testLevelId.description: Optional test-level scope for an initial call.

name: get_test_strategy_page_context
title: Get current Test Strategy page context
